pages.title: Ask and Receive
pages.text: Place a Stock Ticker order and receive its filled shipment from the linked stock network.

pages.title: Ask and Receive
pages.text: Learn the whole request loop instead of merely opening its menu.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Link the native inventory stock nodes and ticker, choose something actually stored, and complete a request. The request and fulfilled package must share the same order identity.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Bind Stock Links to an existing link before placing them on Packagers. Expose inventories to a stock network; the wireless request signal still needs physical package transport.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Bind a Stock Ticker to the network and interact with its seated Stock Keeper. Request items as addressed packages and categorize stock with filters.
